ownSearchBeforeA.note: Before opening A, B leaned covered on n20 (c4fae9a1: moderate anxiety = eustress that enhances performance), n24 (D judged a non-syllabus absolute) and n44 (conversion is taught as somatic, so it can be eliminated). On re-check all three settled to not covered: none of them states the fact the item tests, and a doubtful match is not covered.

disagreementsWithAOnReasons.16: A wrote "Not closable by adding material" because a textbook would call this sublimation. The 2026-27 NCERT reprint (lepy102, printed page 35) prints this very example as reaction formation, so the NTA key agrees with NCERT and a Key card quoting that sentence closes the gap. Verdict (not covered) is the same.

final.rule: Covered only if both A and B say covered; no skill, off-syllabus or dropped items (each passage item needs a stored term the passage does not print).

gapsToAuthor.note: Full dossier with NCERT sentences, pages and routes: tmp/1122-coverage/gaps/psychology.md. All theory; no numericals in this paper.
